hero.8: Skin Boosters and Profhilo in Dubai (Sobha Hartland) - Hydration, Glow and Firmness Without Adding Volume
hero.7: Skin boosters work inside the skin rather than under it: they restore water balance, support collagen and elastin and give back the quality of the skin itself. Profhilo is the best known of them, a bio-remodelling treatment that firms slack skin on the face, neck and hands. All injections are performed by a certified GP doctor with over 15 years of experience.

what.10: A skin booster is an injectable or transdermal treatment that improves the quality of the skin: hydration, elasticity, tone and density.
what.9: It does not create shape and it does not add volume. That is the main difference from everything else on an aesthetic menu, and it is worth being precise about it. Pure hyaluronic boosters suit dryness and dullness; polynucleotides suit thin, sensitive, post-inflammatory skin; exosomes are for repair and for hair; needle-free options are for those who do not want injections at all. The doctor chooses after examining the skin, not from a price list.
what.6: A filler is a dense gel placed under the skin to build volume and contour: cheeks, jawline, chin. A booster is a fluid hyaluronic acid or a bioactive complex distributed within the skin to make it moist, dense and light-reflecting. A filler changes the shape of a face; a booster changes its texture.
what.4: Booster is not classic mesotherapy either
what.3: Mesotherapy delivers a cocktail of vitamins, amino acids and trace elements as a course of frequent small sessions. A booster is a concentrated product with a longer working time, usually one to three sessions. In practice the two are often combined: mesotherapy feeds the skin, a booster rebuilds its structure.
what.0: Profhilo is a high-concentration hyaluronic acid that is not cross-linked into a stiff gel. Instead of holding a shape it spreads through the tissue from a small number of injection points and stimulates the skin to produce its own collagen and elastin. The result is firmer, better hydrated skin with no added volume at all - which is exactly why it suits the neck, the decolletage and skin that looks tired rather than deflated.

benefits.13: Why skin boosters have become the most requested "no one can tell what you did" treatment.
benefits.11: Quality of skin, not a changed face
benefits.10: Nothing about your proportions changes. Colleagues notice that you look rested; nobody can point to what was done.
benefits.8: Works on areas fillers cannot help
benefits.7: Neck, decolletage and hands age through thinning and dehydration rather than lost volume. Boosters and Profhilo are the tools built for exactly that.
benefits.3: A standard Profhilo course is two sessions four weeks apart, with the effect building over the following months as the skin makes its own collagen.
benefits.0: Small papules after Profhilo settle within hours; after Dermapen protocols there is mild redness for a day. Nothing that stops you working.

evTitle.0: Injectable hyaluronic acid boosters and bio-remodelling have been studied in clinical work on skin quality: hydration, elasticity and density are measurable parameters.

evCards.12: Studies of stabilised hyaluronic acid skin boosters report improvement in skin hydration and elasticity measured instrumentally, together with the participants' own assessment of smoothness and glow.
evCards.7: Work on high-concentration non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid describes increased skin firmness and improved elastic properties after a two-session protocol, with the effect developing over the weeks that follow.
evCards.2: Reviews describe the side effect profile as mild and short-lived: transient papules at the injection points, slight redness, occasional small bruises.
evCards.0: The studies refer to the method (injectable skin boosters and bio-remodelling), not to a specific clinic. Results are individual and depend on skin condition, age and lifestyle.

indItems.18: Skin damaged by sun and the Dubai climate
indItems.0: A booster changes the texture of the skin, not the shape of the face. If you need volume or contour, see Dermal Fillers in Dubai.

faq: How is Profhilo different from fillers?

A filler is a dense gel that stays where it is placed and builds volume or contour. Profhilo is a fluid, highly concentrated hyaluronic acid that spreads through the tissue and stimulates your own collagen and elastin. It changes the quality and firmness of the skin without changing the shape of the face, which is why it works on the neck and hands where fillers have little to offer.
How many sessions do I need?

The standard Profhilo protocol is two sessions four weeks apart, then a repeat course after six to nine months. Mesotherapy and Dermapen protocols are usually planned as a short course of three to four sessions, and PRX-T33 can be done as a single pre-event treatment. The number of sessions, the product and the area are what the price depends on, and it is agreed with you at the free consultation.
When will I see the result?

Hydration and glow appear within the first week. Firmness and density build over four to eight weeks, because the skin needs that time to produce new collagen. This is a treatment that rewards patience rather than delivering everything on the day.

Profhilo uses a small number of injection points, and most clients describe it as brief discomfort rather than pain. For Dermapen protocols a topical anaesthetic is applied first. Small papules at the Profhilo points are expected and settle within a few hours.

The effect of a completed course generally holds for six to nine months and fades gradually. Skin condition, age, sun exposure and daily care all influence how long the result stays, and in the Dubai climate consistent sunscreen makes a measurable difference.

How much do skin boosters cost in Dubai?

At SOLAR in Dubai the skin booster price depends on the product, the area and whether you need a single session or a course. The needle-free PRX-T33 protocol is the lightest entry point; Profhilo usually runs as a course of two sessions four weeks apart. The exact price is agreed with you at a free consultation, before anything is booked.

  • PRX-T33 therapy, face. No needles, no downtime, a good pre-event option.
  • Dermapen Genosys Mesotherapy. Face, face and neck, or face, neck and decolletage.
  • Dermapen PDNR, polynucleotides. Face, or face and neck.
  • Dermapen Exosomes ASCE. Face, face and neck, or hair.
  • Profhilo. The standard course is two sessions with a four-week interval.
  • Virtue Aura, needle-free booster. Transdermal delivery without injections.

What changes the price

  • Area: face only, face and neck, or face with neck and decolletage.
  • Product: mesotherapy cocktails, polynucleotides and exosomes sit at different levels of complexity and cost.
  • Course or single session: bio-remodelling works as a protocol, and a single session gives only part of the result.
  • Combination: a booster is often planned alongside a device treatment, and the doctor will build the sequence that gives the most for your budget.

There are no hidden extras: the first consultation is free and the price is agreed with you before the treatment starts.
